baseline_library_defect.mechanism: Delay save POST 1000ms; start typing after 300ms with 100ms key delays so the save response arrives mid-typing.
baseline_library_defect.ownership: Escalated to coordinator; outside the three assigned beads and unchanged by this branch.
baseline_library_defect.reproducer_source:
import conftest  # noqa: F401
from test_fix_ui_library import browser_page, editor, go, lib_site, playwright, status  # noqa: F401
from test_keep_drafts import SLOW_POSTS

pytest_plugins = ["conftest"]


def test_typing_across_a_save_response(tmp_path, lib_site):
    with browser_page(tmp_path, lib_site) as (page, _):
        go(page, "library", item="row-14")
        editor(page).fill("Saved text.")
        page.evaluate(SLOW_POSTS, [r"/api/copy/row-14/revisions", 1000, "ok"])
        page.locator("#sp-save").click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(300)
        editor(page).press("End")
        page.keyboard.type(" Typed later.", delay=100)
        playwright.expect(editor(page)).to_contain_text("Saved text. Typed later.")
